messages.content: Open https://www.w3schools.com/html/html_forms.asp and describe each field in the example form.

The page contains several example forms demonstrating different input types. The fields (with labels and types) are:

- Search field (text input)
- First name: (text input)
- Last name: (text input)
- fname (text input)
- lname (text input)
- HTML (radio button)
- CSS (radio button)
- JavaScript (radio button)
- I have a bike (checkbox)
- I have a car (checkbox)
- I have a boat (checkbox)
- firstname (text input)

These match the visible examples of text fields, radio buttons, and checkboxes shown on the page (plus the site search box).
